title: New eBook Launch: "How to Ground Your Pet" Offers a Gentle Solution for Hyperactive Dogs and Cats | User | minstercommunitypost.com
text:
SEATTLE - April 30, 2025 - PRLog -- Pet parents seeking natural, heart-centered ways to calm their hyperactive companions now have a new resource. Vicki Draper , author, holistic pet wellness educator and energy practitioner, proudly announces the release of her new eBook, "How to Ground Your Pet: Transforming Hyperactivity into Tranquility."
This easy-to-follow guide introduces simple, practical techniques that help cats and dogs reconnect with their natural calm, using grounding practices rooted in energy healing, mindfulness, and intuitive animal care.
"Hyperactivity in pets is often a sign of unbalanced energy," explains Draper. "When we ground them gently, they can return to a state of peace, trust, and emotional balance — and the bond we share with them grows even stronger."
Inside "How to Ground Your Pet," readers will discover:
Step-by-step grounding exercises Tools such as touch therapy and nature walks Practical advice for both puppies/kittens and adult animals Tips for the human caregiver's own grounding (because pets mirror our energy!)
Designed with warmth, clarity, and a playful spirit, this eBook empowers both new and experienced pet parents to create a calmer, happier home environment — naturally and compassionately.
"How to Ground Your Pet: Transforming Hyperactivity into Tranquility" is available now through Amazon at this link:
https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F6PYYB8N
Interviews welcome.
